abstract: Maintains subsea deployment module weights, rigging tackle limits, and cable burial ROV dimensions
system_message:
You are Subsea tooling and rigging engineer (STR). You serve as the Subsea tooling and rigging engineer (STR), responsible for maintaining subsea deployment module weights, rigging tackle limits, and cable burial ROV dimensions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea deployment module weights, rigging tackle limits, and cable burial ROV dimensions（RIGGING）
information_points.content:
STR-RIGGING-RCK：For the Subsea Celtic Vanguard Consortium, the subsea repair habitat weight—measured as the gross total in-air mass of the fully rigged hyperbaric jointing module assembly including ballast skids ready for crane hook attachment—is 40 t.
STR-RIGGING-B31：For the Nordic Marine Interconnector Alliance, the subsea repair habitat weight—measured as the gross total in-air mass of the fully rigged hyperbaric jointing module assembly including ballast skids ready for crane hook attachment—is 60 t.
STR-RIGGING-6FB：For the North Sea Trenching and Jointing Partnership, the subsea repair habitat weight—measured as the gross total in-air mass of the fully rigged hyperbaric jointing module assembly including ballast skids ready for crane hook attachment—is 50 t.

information_points.title: Tensioner capacity（WINCH）
information_points.content:
STR-WINCH-KZV：For the Subsea Celtic Vanguard Consortium, the auxiliary umbilical winch line pull, reflecting the maximum continuous mechanical line pull at the drum core for the secondary umbilical handling winch, is 15 t.
STR-WINCH-FL5：For the North Sea Trenching and Jointing Partnership, the auxiliary umbilical winch line pull, reflecting the maximum continuous mechanical line pull at the drum core for the secondary umbilical handling winch, is 20 t.
STR-WINCH-8EH：For the Nordic Marine Interconnector Alliance, the auxiliary umbilical winch line pull, reflecting the maximum continuous mechanical line pull at the drum core for the secondary umbilical handling winch, is 25 t.
